--- a/tinychat/llms/_curl.py
+++ b/tinychat/llms/_curl.py
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+import io
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import pycurl
+
+
+@dataclass
+class CurlResponse:
+    status_code: int
+    body: bytes
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        return iter(self.body.splitlines())
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SSEEvent:
+    data: str
+
+
+class SSEStream:
+    def __init__(self, event_source):
+        if hasattr(event_source, "body"):
+            body = event_source.body
+        elif hasattr(event_source, "content"):
+            body = event_source.content
+        elif isinstance(event_source, (bytes, bytearray)):
+            body = bytes(event_source)
+        else:
+            body = b"".join(event_source)
+
+        if isinstance(body, str):
+            body = body.encode("utf-8")
+        self._body = body
+
+    def events(self):
+        body_text = self._body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").replace("\r\n", "\n")
+        for chunk in body_text.split("\n\n"):
+            data_lines = []
+            for line in chunk.splitlines():
+                if line.startswith("data:"):
+                    data_lines.append(line[5:].lstrip())
+            if data_lines:
+                yield SSEEvent("\n".join(data_lines))
+
+
+class _RequestsCompat:
+    def post(self, url, headers=None, json=None, stream=False):
+        return post_json(url, headers or {}, json or {})
+
+
+requests = _RequestsCompat()
+SSEClient = SSEStream
+
+
+def post_json(url, headers, payload):
+    body_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    curl = pycurl.Curl()
+    try:
+        payload_bytes = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.URL, url)
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.POST, 1)
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, payload_bytes)
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDSIZE, len(payload_bytes))
+        curl.setopt(
+            pycurl.HTTPHEADER,
+            [f"{name}: {value}" for name, value in headers.items()],
+        )
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.WRITEFUNCTION, body_buffer.write)
+        curl.perform()
+        return CurlResponse(int(curl.getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE)), body_buffer.getvalue())
+    finally:
+        curl.close()
